# google_vertex_ai_rag_file

A RagFile is a single file that has been imported into a Vertex AI RAG Engine
RagCorpus, where it is parsed, chunked, embedded, and indexed.

Each `google_vertex_ai_rag_file` imports exactly one file from either
Cloud Storage or Google Drive using the `ragFiles:import` method.

~> **Note:** The RAG Engine service agent
(`service-PROJECT_NUMBER@gcp-sa-vertex-rag.iam.gserviceaccount.com`) must be
able to read the source file. If the source file content already exists in the
RagCorpus, the import is skipped by the API and resource creation fails.


To get more information about RagFile, see:

* [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.ragCorpora.ragFiles)
* How-to Guides
    * [Manage your RAG files](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/build/rag-engine/manage-your-rag-corpus)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Rag File Gcs


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_file" "example" {
  region     = "europe-west4"
  rag_corpus = google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus.name

  gcs_source {
    uris = ["gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.file.name}"]
  }

  depends_on = [google_storage_bucket_iam_member.rag_service_agent]
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus" "rag_corpus" {
  display_name = "rag-corpus-file"
  region       = "europe-west4"

  vector_db_config {
    rag_managed_db {
      knn {}
    }

    rag_embedding_model_config {
      vertex_prediction_endpoint {
        endpoint = "projects/${data.google_project.project.number}/locations/europe-west4/publishers/google/models/text-embedding-005"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "tf-test-rag-file"
  location                    = "EUROPE-WEST4"
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
  force_destroy               = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "file" {
  name    = "example.txt"
  bucket  = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  content = "Vertex AI RAG Engine lets large language models retrieve information from your own documents."
}

# The RAG Engine service agent is created on first use of RAG Engine, so grant it
# access after the RagCorpus exists.
resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "rag_service_agent" {
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-vertex-rag.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

  depends_on = [google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus]
}

data "google_project" "project" {
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Rag File Full


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_file" "example" {
  region     = "europe-west4"
  rag_corpus = google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus.name

  gcs_source {
    uris = ["gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.file.name}"]
  }

  rag_file_parsing_config {
    llm_parser {
      model_name                   = "projects/${data.google_project.project.project_id}/locations/europe-west4/publishers/google/models/gemini-2.5-flash"
      max_parsing_requests_per_min = 100
      custom_parsing_prompt        = "Extract the text content of the document."
    }
  }

  rag_file_transformation_config {
    rag_file_chunking_config {
      fixed_length_chunking {
        chunk_size    = 512
        chunk_overlap = 100
      }
    }
  }

  max_embedding_requests_per_min = 500

  depends_on = [google_storage_bucket_iam_member.rag_service_agent]
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus" "rag_corpus" {
  display_name = "rag-corpus-file-full"
  region       = "europe-west4"

  vector_db_config {
    rag_managed_db {
      knn {}
    }

    rag_embedding_model_config {
      vertex_prediction_endpoint {
        endpoint = "projects/${data.google_project.project.number}/locations/europe-west4/publishers/google/models/text-embedding-005"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "tf-test-rag-file-full"
  location                    = "EUROPE-WEST4"
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
  force_destroy               = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "file" {
  name    = "example.txt"
  bucket  = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  content = "Vertex AI RAG Engine lets large language models retrieve information from your own documents."
}

# The RAG Engine service agent is created on first use of RAG Engine, so grant it
# access after the RagCorpus exists.
resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "rag_service_agent" {
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-vertex-rag.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

  depends_on = [google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus]
}

data "google_project" "project" {
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Rag File Layout Parser


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_file" "example" {
  region     = "europe-west4"
  rag_corpus = google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus.name

  gcs_source {
    uris = ["gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.file.name}"]
  }

  rag_file_parsing_config {
    layout_parser {
      processor_name               = google_document_ai_processor.layout_parser.id
      max_parsing_requests_per_min = 100
    }
  }

  depends_on = [
    google_storage_bucket_iam_member.rag_service_agent,
    google_project_iam_member.rag_service_agent_document_ai,
  ]
}

resource "google_document_ai_processor" "layout_parser" {
  location     = "eu"
  display_name = "rag-layout-parser"
  type         = "LAYOUT_PARSER_PROCESSOR"
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus" "rag_corpus" {
  display_name = "rag-corpus-file-layout"
  region       = "europe-west4"

  vector_db_config {
    rag_managed_db {
      knn {}
    }

    rag_embedding_model_config {
      vertex_prediction_endpoint {
        endpoint = "projects/${data.google_project.project.number}/locations/europe-west4/publishers/google/models/text-embedding-005"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "tf-test-rag-file-layout"
  location                    = "EUROPE-WEST4"
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
  force_destroy               = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "file" {
  name         = "example.html"
  bucket       = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  content_type = "text/html"
  content      = "<html><body><h1>Vertex AI RAG Engine</h1><p>RAG Engine lets large language models retrieve information from your own documents.</p></body></html>"
}

# The RAG Engine service agent is created on first use of RAG Engine, so grant it
# access after the RagCorpus exists.
resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "rag_service_agent" {
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-vertex-rag.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

  depends_on = [google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus]
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "rag_service_agent_document_ai" {
  project = data.google_project.project.project_id
  role    = "roles/documentai.apiUser"
  member  = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-vertex-rag.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

  depends_on = [google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus]
}

data "google_project" "project" {
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Rag File Google Drive


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_file" "example" {
  region     = "europe-west4"
  rag_corpus = google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus.rag_corpus.name

  # The Google Drive file must be shared with
  # service-PROJECT_NUMBER@gcp-sa-vertex-rag.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
  google_drive_source {
    resource_ids {
      resource_id   = "GOOGLE_DRIVE_FILE_ID"
      resource_type = "RESOURCE_TYPE_FILE"
    }
  }
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus" "rag_corpus" {
  display_name = "rag-corpus-drive"
  region       = "europe-west4"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `region` -
  (Required)
  The region of the RagCorpus. eg europe-west4

* `rag_corpus` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the RagCorpus to import the file into, for example the `name`
  attribute of a `google_vertex_ai_rag_corpus` resource.


* `gcs_source` -
  (Optional)
  The Cloud Storage location of the file to import.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_gcs_source).

* `google_drive_source` -
  (Optional)
  The Google Drive location of the file to import.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_google_drive_source).

* `rag_file_parsing_config` -
  (Optional)
  The parsing config used when importing the file. The default parser is used
  if this field is not set.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rag_file_parsing_config).

* `rag_file_transformation_config` -
  (Optional)
  The transformation config used when importing the file.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rag_file_transformation_config).

* `max_embedding_requests_per_min` -
  (Optional)
  The maximum number of queries per minute that the import is allowed to make
  to the embedding model specified on the RagCorpus.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_gcs_source"></a>The `gcs_source` block supports:

* `uris` -
  (Required)
  The Cloud Storage URI of the file to import, for example
  `gs://my-bucket/my-file.pdf`. Must reference a single file; directories
  and wildcards are not supported because each resource manages one RagFile.

<a name="nested_google_drive_source"></a>The `google_drive_source` block supports:

* `resource_ids` -
  (Required)
  The Google Drive file to import.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_google_drive_source_resource_ids).


<a name="nested_google_drive_source_resource_ids"></a>The `resource_ids` block supports:

* `resource_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the Google Drive file.

* `resource_type` -
  (Optional)
  The type of the Google Drive resource. Only individual files are
  supported because each resource manages one RagFile.
  Default value is `RESOURCE_TYPE_FILE`.
  Possible values are: `RESOURCE_TYPE_FILE`.

<a name="nested_rag_file_parsing_config"></a>The `rag_file_parsing_config` block supports:

* `layout_parser` -
  (Optional)
  The Document AI Layout Parser to use for the file.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rag_file_parsing_config_layout_parser).

* `llm_parser` -
  (Optional)
  The LLM parser to use for the file.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rag_file_parsing_config_llm_parser).


<a name="nested_rag_file_parsing_config_layout_parser"></a>The `layout_parser` block supports:

* `processor_name` -
  (Optional)
  The full resource name of a Document AI processor or processor version
  of type `LAYOUT_PARSER_PROCESSOR`. Format:
  `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}` or
  `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}/processorVersions/{processor_version_id}`.

* `max_parsing_requests_per_min` -
  (Optional)
  The maximum number of requests the job is allowed to make to the
  Document AI processor per minute.

<a name="nested_rag_file_parsing_config_llm_parser"></a>The `llm_parser` block supports:

* `model_name` -
  (Optional)
  The name of a LLM model used for parsing. Format:
  `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/publishers/{publisher}/models/{model}`.

* `max_parsing_requests_per_min` -
  (Optional)
  The maximum number of requests the job is allowed to make to the LLM
  model per minute.

* `custom_parsing_prompt` -
  (Optional)
  The prompt to use for parsing. If not specified, a default prompt is used.

<a name="nested_rag_file_transformation_config"></a>The `rag_file_transformation_config` block supports:

* `rag_file_chunking_config` -
  (Optional)
  The chunking config for the file.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rag_file_transformation_config_rag_file_chunking_config).


<a name="nested_rag_file_transformation_config_rag_file_chunking_config"></a>The `rag_file_chunking_config` block supports:

* `fixed_length_chunking` -
  (Optional)
  The fixed length chunking config.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rag_file_transformation_config_rag_file_chunking_config_fixed_length_chunking).


<a name="nested_rag_file_transformation_config_rag_file_chunking_config_fixed_length_chunking"></a>The `fixed_length_chunking` block supports:

* `chunk_size` -
  (Optional)
  The size of the chunks.

* `chunk_overlap` -
  (Optional)
  The overlap between chunks.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/ragCorpora/{{rag_corpus}}/ragFiles/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The generated ID of the RagFile.

* `display_name` -
  The display name of the RagFile, derived by the API from the source file.

* `description` -
  The description of the RagFile.

* `create_time` -
  Timestamp when this RagFile was created.

* `update_time` -
  Timestamp when this RagFile was last updated.

* `user_metadata` -
  The metadata for metadata search, in JSON format.

* `file_status` -
  State of the RagFile.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_file_status).


<a name="nested_file_status"></a>The `file_status` block contains:

* `state` -
  (Output)
  RagFile state.

* `error_status` -
  (Output)
  Only populated when the state is ERROR.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 30 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


RagFile can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/ragCorpora/{{rag_corpus}}/ragFiles/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{rag_corpus}}/{{name}}`
* `{{region}}/{{rag_corpus}}/{{name}}`
* `{{rag_corpus}}/{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import RagFile using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    region = "<-required value->"
    ragCorpus = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_rag_file.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import RagFile using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/ragCorpora/{{rag_corpus}}/ragFiles/{{name}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_rag_file.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), RagFile can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_rag_file.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/ragCorpora/{{rag_corpus}}/ragFiles/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_rag_file.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{rag_corpus}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_rag_file.default {{region}}/{{rag_corpus}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_rag_file.default {{rag_corpus}}/{{name}}
```
